comparisons.what: Aerial images computed independently using the Abbe formulation and the Hopkins formulation are compared to verify that they agree.
The oscillation of the CD change of the isolated line as its neighbour moves away is compared with the mutual coherence function.
The optimized free-form source is compared with the best parametric source.
Depth of focus and OPC features through pitch are compared across different illumination sources.

constraints: Exposure is held fixed at wavelength 193.368 nm through water with refractive index 1.436 using a projection lens of NA 1.35.
The mask is held fixed as a thin 6% attenuated phase-shift mask where dark regions transmit amplitude sqrt(0.06) with a phase of pi under the Kirchhoff thin-mask approximation.
Imaging is constrained to a scalar model without polarization, and the paper must state plainly that at NA 1.35 a scalar model overstates contrast and depth of focus.
The partially coherent aerial image must be computed independently via Abbe and Hopkins formulations, and both implementations must agree.
Optical spatial frequencies reaching the wafer are constrained to not exceed NA*(1+sigma_max)/lambda.
Patterns are constrained to vertical lines and spaces with a fixed target line width of 40 nm.
Resist imaging is constrained to a constant-threshold aerial image with no resist blur.
Dose is anchored so the densest pitch prints at 40 nm at best focus, and one-dimensional OPC must set the mask line width at every pitch to print at 40 nm at best focus.
The free-form pixelated source optimization is constrained to maintain mirror symmetry.
Implementation is restricted to Python using numpy and scipy, with matplotlib using the Agg backend.
Computation is restricted to CPU only, a long run of several hours is permitted for source optimization, and the runtime must be reported.
Every number must be reported with its numerical error (grid, source sampling, focus step), and results that are only checks of the code must be explicitly stated as such.
Citations are restricted to sources actually found and read, and any unconfirmed reference must be acknowledged as such rather than cited.
